---
title: MCP Console Python
description: Python clients and adapters for persistent R, Python, and SQL sessions.
---

`mcp_console` connects Python applications and model frameworks to Console's persistent workbench.
This package connects your application to Console; it is separate from the Python environment used by the agent's analysis.
Use this site for exact signatures and complete integration examples; use the [guides](https://t-kalinowski.github.io/mcp-console/CLIENTS.html) for runtime behavior and configuration.

## Start without a model

Install the `client` extra with Python 3.11 or newer:

```sh
pip install 'mcp-console[client]'
```

```python
from mcp_console import MCPConsole

with MCPConsole() as console:
    print(console.send(python="values = [12, 15, 18]; values"))
    print(console.send(python="sum(values) / len(values)"))
```

Keep the connection open to retain state.
Use [MCPConsole](reference/MCPConsole.qmd) for synchronous calls or [AsyncMCPConsole](reference/AsyncMCPConsole.qmd) for asynchronous calls.
Reconnect starts a new session.

## Add a model framework

Install the matching extra instead of `client`.
Reference examples describe provider credentials, model selection, and cleanup.

::: {.table-responsive tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Framework integrations"}

| Framework                    | Extra           | Existing Console connection                           | Framework-managed connection                                 |
| ---------------------------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| chatlas                      | `chatlas`       | [tool](reference/chatlas.tool.qmd)                    | [register](reference/chatlas.register.qmd)                   |
| `openai` — Responses API     | `openai`        | [responses_tool](reference/openai.responses_tool.qmd) | Application-owned loop.                                      |
| `openai-agents` — Agents SDK | `openai-agents` | [agents_tool](reference/openai.agents_tool.qmd)       | [agents_server](reference/openai.agents_server.qmd)          |
| `openai-codex` — Codex SDK   | `codex`         | —                                                     | [server](reference/codex.server.qmd) supplies configuration. |
| Anthropic                    | `anthropic`     | [tool](reference/anthropic.tool.qmd)                  | [tools](reference/anthropic.tools.qmd)                       |

:::

Responses and native MCP integrations preserve images.
Text-tool adapters return MIME placeholders for images.
Create adapters from the connected server so they retain its actual schema, rather than inferring it from method annotations.

## Calls and dependencies

A call can stop waiting while code continues.
Poll without code to collect output; do not resubmit the cell.
The [Python guide](https://t-kalinowski.github.io/mcp-console/PYTHON.html) explains connection ownership and requirements inspection.
[Requirements](reference/Requirements.qmd) documents the client declaration type.
